title: Minecraft NSD Anarchy Server
description: NSD is a newly arrived anarchic server in China. Both Java offline players without anti-cheat and legitimate players can join. The server version supports 1.21.11-1.8, and it also has copy plugins, TPA plugins, and home setting plugins.
